code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Arterial blood gas indicates acidemia (low pH). Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic respiratory failure with associated bone marrow suppression or infiltration; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
